welcome.tagline:
Your keys, your coins.
Simple as a tap.
welcome.featureNoMnemonicBody: Create and sign in with a passkey on your device — no 12 words to copy down and guard.
welcome.featureOneAddressBody: The same address works on every supported network, and you can add your own.
welcome.featureOpenSourceBody: The app and backend services are open source — you can run a stack that is entirely your own.
welcome.featureKeyCustodyTitle: Keys live in your password manager
welcome.featureKeyCustodyBody: Passkeys are kept by Apple Passwords or Google Password Manager — Vela never touches them.
welcome.featureSafeContractBody: Accounts are built on audited Safe contracts, not a custom implementation.
welcome.featureStablecoinGasBody: Most networks let you pay fees in stablecoins — no need to hold the native coin first.
welcome.heroSubtitle: Sign with a passkey. Vela never sees your key.

intro.noSeedBody: Create your wallet with this device's fingerprint or face. No twelve words to write on paper, hide in a drawer, and fail to find one day.
intro.custodyBody: Your passkeys live where you keep them: this device's password manager, or a hardware security key. Vela can't reach them, and can't spend for you.
intro.chainsBody: The same address works on 12+ networks, and fees can be paid in stablecoins — no stocking up on a native coin for each one.

meta.title: Vela Wallet — the passkey wallet
meta.description: A passkey wallet with no seed phrase: one address across 12+ networks, audited Safe v1.4.1 contracts, stablecoin gas, fully open source and self-hostable.

settings.title: Settings
settings.passkeyHint: This service stores your passkey's public key for cross-device sign-in. Vela Wallet never has access to your passkey's private key.
settings.warningText: The Passkey Index service is unreachable. Wallet creation and sign-in require this service. Please configure a reachable endpoint below.

common.cancelledVerifyBody: Retry verification to finish creating your wallet.

create.accountNameHint: This name is stored with your public key on-chain for cross-device sign-in.
create.ack0: My public key and wallet name are written into the on-chain contract.
create.ack1: My private key stays in my device's password manager or security key. Vela never sees it.
create.ack2: I have read and agree to the
create.alertNotDiscoverableBody:
Your device saved this passkey only on this device, so it wouldn't appear when you sign in and couldn't recover your wallet later. To keep you safe, no wallet was created — nothing is lost.

In system settings, set Google Password Manager or iCloud Keychain as your passkey provider, then simply try again.
create.alertNotSupportedBody: Biometric authentication is not available on this device.
create.identiconHint: An identity pattern generated from the address
create.keyUnreadableBody: A security key is plugged in, but this computer will not let the wallet read it. That is a permissions setting rather than a fault in the key — on Linux, install your distribution's FIDO udev rules (libu2f-udev, or systemd 252 and later, which sets them up itself), then unplug the key and plug it in again.
create.keyUnreadableTitle: Your security key can't be opened
create.keysHint: The wallet address is decided by this set of keys — none can be added or removed after creation.
create.keysSubtitle: Any one of them can sign in on its own. Up to 7.
create.keysSubtitleBlocked: With two keys, losing one still leaves you a way in.
create.keysTitleBlocked: One more key before you can create
create.methodHybridBody: Scan a code and create it on a nearby device
create.methodSecurityKeyBody: Plug it in and touch it
create.nameTooLong: This name is too long to fit in a passkey — please shorten it.
create.needSecondKeyHint: This key exists only on this device, with no synced backup. Lose the device and the wallet cannot be opened.
create.pinBody: {{product}} has no fingerprint sensor, so its PIN is how it confirms it is you. The PIN goes only to the key in your hand — never to this computer's disk, and never to a server.
create.pinRejected: That PIN was not accepted. The key locks itself when the attempts run out, and only a reset clears it — which erases every passkey on it.
create.progressSubtitle: Deriving the address from {{count}} keys. The contract deploys with your first transaction — no gas now.
create.reportPrefill: Wallet created, but syncing the public key to the server failed.
create.securityKeyRequiredBody: This computer has no system passkey service. Plug in a FIDO2 USB security key and try again.
create.startOverBtn: Start over with a new passkey
create.statusVerifyCancelled: Verification was cancelled. Please try again.
create.stepCreateDetail: Derive the address and write the key index.
create.stepKeysDetail: Add passkeys. Any one of them can sign in on its own.
create.stepNamingDetail: Name your wallet. It goes on-chain with your public key.
create.successMessage: Any of your {{count}} keys can sign in on its own. The contract deploys with your first transaction.
create.syncFailedHint: Check your network, or configure a custom endpoint below.
create.syncFailedMessage: Wallet created, but your public key wasn't synced to the server. You won't be able to sign in on other devices until this is resolved.
create.touchBody: {{product}} is blinking and waiting for you. Touch it now to confirm.
create.touchFingerprintBody: {{product}} is blinking. Rest your finger on its sensor to confirm it is you.
create.touchSelectBody: Several security keys are plugged in and all of them are blinking. Touch the one you want to use.
create.verifyHint: Your passkey is verified and your key is synced — you're all set.
create.verifyStuckHint: Verification keeps failing? Your device may not have saved this passkey properly. It's safe to start over — nothing has been created yet.

login.alertNotSupportedBody: Biometric authentication is not available on this device.
login.alertIncompatibleBody: Your device's identity provider is not compatible with Vela Wallet. Please switch to Google Password Manager in system settings and try again.
login.alertNotFoundBody:
No wallet was found for this identity.

Possible reasons:
• You haven't created a wallet yet
• Your identity hasn't synced to this device (check iCloud / Google settings)
• The public key server is unreachable

Try creating a new wallet, or ensure your identity provider (Face ID / fingerprint) is synced across devices.
login.alertSignInFailedBody:
{{message}}

Make sure your device has Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint set up and try again.
login.alertIncompatibleBodyCreate: Your device's identity provider is not compatible with this wallet. Please switch to Google Password Manager in system settings and try again.
login.recoverOfferBody: The key server has no record of this passkey yet. Confirm one more signature to rebuild its public key — and your wallet address — on this device.
login.recoverFailedBody: We couldn't rebuild your wallet from those signatures. Nothing was changed — please try again in a moment.
login.statusAwaitingPasskeyHint: Confirm with Face ID or your fingerprint in the system prompt.
login.statusCancelledBody: The system passkey sheet was closed, so nothing was signed.
login.successMessage: Your wallet is restored on this device.
login.signInFailedBody: Make sure Face ID, Touch ID or a fingerprint is set up on this device.
login.pickBody: {{product}} holds more than one Vela wallet. Choose the one to sign in to.

storage.unreadableTitle: This browser's wallet data can't be read
storage.unreadableBody: The stored wallet list is in a form this version cannot read. Sign in again to rebuild it from your passkey, or reset this browser's copy. The wallet itself is untouched: it lives on the chain, behind your passkey.
